x: Syd Jarlett, although looking a bit thin on top, won the 440 Yards, and Rene Howell, our Poly member, sportingly turned out and gained a point by finishing fifth. Len Marchant, on leave from the R.A.F., won the 880 Yards in fine style, and a new member in D.

Jack Frost was second in the first 220 Yards, while Ted Read won the second-string race. Len Marchant found young Anzola, the T.V.H. lad, a little too speedy down the straight in the 880, but Len Herbert won the 1 Mile with D.
Freestone ran well to beat Dicky Dumbrill for premier honours with Hawkins in third place. The 1 Mile Handicap was won by D.
Syd Jarlett and Bob Wise finished second and third in the 440, and Len Marchant won the 880 Yards, with Alf Orton fourth. D.
Mackenzie (7) reaping the reward of his perseverance throughout the season, gaining third place. A small field turned out for the 880 yards, and we were pleased to see D.
